receiver.hint: Drag the blue marker on the map to move the receive point

gpsErrors.unsupported: This browser cannot access your location. Drag the marker on the map instead
gpsErrors.permissionDenied: Location access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings or drag the marker on the map
gpsErrors.unavailable: Your location is currently unavailable. Try again or drag the marker on the map
gpsErrors.timeout: The GPS request timed out. Try again or drag the marker on the map
gpsErrors.unknown: Your location could not be read. Try again or drag the marker on the map

empty.stationDescription: Open a station's details and choose Analyze terrain profile under Actions

states.processing: Reading LiDAR terrain and running analysis...
states.failed: The profile could not be calculated
states.failedDescription: Check the selected endpoints and try again
states.outOfAzimuth: The receiver is outside the selected antenna's main azimuth. Choose a different sector to see the profile

selection.title: Antenna sector
selection.required: Choose an antenna sector to run the analysis

verdict.surfaceOnly: The terrain itself is clear. Buildings or vegetation constrain the path

description.clear: Terrain, buildings and vegetation do not obstruct the modeled path. This favors reception, but actual signal and speed may vary
description.constrained: The modeled path passes close to terrain, buildings or vegetation. Reception may be less reliable
description.blocked: Terrain, buildings or vegetation obstruct the modeled path. Reception may be weaker or less stable
description.unavailable: Building and vegetation coverage is incomplete, so reception conditions cannot be assessed reliably

metrics.pathLossDescription: Signal attenuation along the modeled path according to ITU-R P.1812. Lower values mean less loss. This estimate does not include the station's actual transmit power or directional antenna pattern
metrics.beamOffsetDescription: Vertical angle between the receiver direction and the estimated beam center. Closer to 0° means the receiver is closer to the beam axis, "+" means above it and "-" means below it
metrics.beamOffsetUnavailableDescription: The offset cannot be calculated because this data source does not provide a reliable antenna tilt
metrics.fieldStrengthDescription: Field strength describes how strong the electromagnetic field is at the receiver location and is expressed in dBµV/m. Here it is calculated by ITU-R P.1812 for 1 kW ERP. Higher values mean a stronger reference field. It is not the phone's actual signal level and does not predict data speed

chart.label: Terrain and line-of-sight profile
chart.description: Cross-section from the receiver on the left to the selected station on the right. The chart shows terrain, surface objects, and the direct ray with ITU-R P.1812-8 prediction

codes.ANTENNA_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Choose the antenna sector to continue
codes.ANTENNA_SELECTION_INVALID: The selected antenna is no longer available
codes.SI2PEM_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE: No matching SI2PEM report was available
codes.SI2PEM_REPORT_PARSE_FAILED: The latest SI2PEM report could not be read reliably
codes.UKE_ANTENNA_FALLBACK: A UKE permit height was used because SI2PEM data was unavailable
codes.NETWORKS_SHARING_DATA: Antenna data comes from the co-located partner network station (T-Mobile/Orange RAN sharing)
codes.ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_MISMATCH: The receiver is outside the selected antenna's main azimuth
codes.SURFACE_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Surface and vegetation data was unavailable
codes.SURFACE_MODEL_PARTIAL: Surface and vegetation coverage is incomplete along this path
codes.TERRAIN_MODEL_PARTIAL: Terrain coverage is incomplete along this path
codes.TERRAIN_CACHE_STALE: Cached terrain data may be older than the current GUGiK model
